articles.event_key: 糖基水凝胶|反复弯曲后增强|聚合物
articles.title: 糖基水凝胶反复弯折后变强而非疲劳
articles.summary: 华盛顿大学圣路易斯分校团队在《自然·材料》报告一种糖晶体与聚乙二醇水凝胶，反复弯曲后环糊精环重组使材料增强；目前仅小批量制备，医疗应用尚在探索。
articles.new_facts: 《自然·材料》发表糖基水凝胶研究，弯折1万次后增强；环糊精环沿聚合物链滑动并重组；目前一次制备数十克。

facts.text: 华盛顿大学圣路易斯分校化学教授Chenfeng Ke（Ke）领导的团队在《自然·材料》发表研究，报告一种由糖晶体和聚乙二醇构成的水凝胶在反复弯曲、拉伸后强度提高，而非像多数材料那样疲劳弱化。团队在模拟膝关节的柔性接头上弯折1万次，称材料表现与预测一致。

evidence.quote: The breakthrough was described in a study published online in Nature Materials .
Our smart material actually gets stronger the more it's bent and strained
We bent it 10,000 times, and the material performed just as we predicted

facts.text: 材料中的环糊精形成环状结构，拉伸使环糊精环簇解体并沿聚合物链滑动，材料松弛时重组为更小的结晶区域，从而在应变位置局部增强。研究人员认为这种机制类似胶原蛋白等生物材料，并设想用于人工关节或组织修复。

evidence.quote: Stretching breaks apart large clusters of cyclodextrin rings, which slide along polymer chains and reorganize into smaller crystalline structures when the material relaxes.
In many ways, the material mimics biological materials in the human body, including collagen, a protein that gives skin its strength and elasticity.
the material could be used to support artificial joints or to repair damaged tissues

facts.text: 团队表示目前一次仅能制备数十克材料，医疗应用仍需与骨科和器械专家合作探索。

evidence.quote: So far, Ke and his team have produced the material in small quantities, just tens of grams at a time.
We want to work with experts at WashU Medicine and elsewhere to explore the possibilities

entities: 华盛顿大学圣路易斯分校（Washington University in St. Louis）
articles.limitations: 来源为大学新闻稿转述的同行评审论文；材料仅小批量制备，医疗应用尚未验证。

bilingual.title_en: Sugar-Based Hydrogel Strengthens Rather Than Fatigues After Repeated Bending

sentences.en: A team led by Chenfeng Ke (Ke), a chemistry professor at Washington University in St. Louis, published research in Nature Materials reporting that a hydrogel made of sugar crystals and polyethylene glycol increases in strength after repeated bending and stretching, rather than weakening from fatigue like most materials.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿大学圣路易斯分校化学教授Chenfeng Ke（Ke）领导的团队在《自然·材料》发表研究，报告一种由糖晶体和聚乙二醇构成的水凝胶在反复弯曲、拉伸后强度提高，而非像多数材料那样疲劳弱化。

sentences.en: The team bent the material 10,000 times on a flexible joint simulating a knee joint and said its behavior matched predictions.
sentences.zh: 团队在模拟膝关节的柔性接头上弯折1万次，称材料表现与预测一致。

sentences.en: Cyclodextrin in the material forms ring-shaped structures; stretching causes clusters of cyclodextrin rings to disassemble and slide along polymer chains, and when the material relaxes, they reassemble into smaller crystalline regions, thereby locally reinforcing the strained locations.
sentences.zh: 材料中的环糊精形成环状结构，拉伸使环糊精环簇解体并沿聚合物链滑动，材料松弛时重组为更小的结晶区域，从而在应变位置局部增强。

sentences.en: The researchers believe this mechanism resembles biological materials such as collagen and envision applications in artificial joints or tissue repair.
sentences.zh: 研究人员认为这种机制类似胶原蛋白等生物材料，并设想用于人工关节或组织修复。

sentences.en: The team said it can currently prepare only tens of grams of the material at a time, and medical applications still require exploration in collaboration with orthopedic and device experts.
sentences.zh: 团队表示目前一次仅能制备数十克材料，医疗应用仍需与骨科和器械专家合作探索。

articles.event_key: 过氧化氢合成|实现|无贵金属催化路线
articles.title: 无金属分子电催化剂将氧还原为过氧化氢
articles.summary: 罗格斯大学纽瓦克分校与波恩大学在《自然通讯》报告无金属、无氢气的过氧化氢电合成路线，实验室选择性超过99%；催化剂寿命和放大仍需验证。
articles.new_facts: 《自然通讯》发表无金属分子电催化剂制过氧化氢研究；实验室电荷利用率超过99%；催化剂寿命与放大待验证。

facts.text: 罗格斯大学纽瓦克分校与波恩大学研究人员在《自然通讯》发表研究，描述一种不含金属、也不使用氢气的过氧化氢制备方法：以氧、电流和质子源为原料，用分子电催化剂完成氧还原。

evidence.quote: chemists from Rutgers University–Newark in the US and the University of Bonn have now described an alternative technique
Their findings have now been published in the journal Nature Communications .
we looked at a new way to make hydrogen peroxide using a molecular electrocatalyst that needs no metals or hydrogen gas. Instead, we use oxygen, an electric current and a proton source.

facts.text: 实验室结果显示，超过99%的电荷用于生成目标产物，催化剂转换频率很高；计算与实验将反应归为“自由基回弹”机制，即生成的过氧羟基自由基先与催化剂结合，再释放过氧化氢。

evidence.quote: More than 99% of the electric charge that was applied was used to create the desired product, and the catalyst also achieved very high turnover frequencies.

Our calculations support an unusual mechanism known as the "radical rebound," where the hydroperoxyl radical (HO₂•) that is initially formed following the hydrogen transfer binds to the catalyst again ("rebound") before hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) is released in subsequent reaction steps.

facts.text: 研究团队指出，催化剂稳定性和寿命仍需测试改进，反应放大及在水中的运行也待验证，目前尚处实验室阶段。

evidence.quote: the stability and lifespan of the catalyst need to be tested and improved to handle longer operating times and a larger scale to produce hydrogen peroxide.
However, there are still some fundamental challenges to overcome with further development steps before the technique might be suitable for industrial application.

entities: 罗格斯大学纽瓦克分校/波恩大学（Rutgers University–Newark / University of Bonn）
articles.limitations: 来源为大学Q&A转述的同行评审论文；结果处于实验室阶段，催化剂寿命、放大和水相运行尚待验证。

bilingual.title_en: Metal-free molecular electrocatalyst reduces oxygen to hydrogen peroxide

sentences.en: Researchers at Rutgers University–Newark and the University of Bonn have published a study in Nature Communications describing a method for producing hydrogen peroxide that uses neither metal nor hydrogen: with oxygen, electric current, and a proton source as inputs, a molecular electrocatalyst carries out oxygen reduction.
sentences.zh: 罗格斯大学纽瓦克分校与波恩大学研究人员在《自然通讯》发表研究，描述一种不含金属、也不使用氢气的过氧化氢制备方法：以氧、电流和质子源为原料，用分子电催化剂完成氧还原。

sentences.en: Laboratory results showed that more than 99% of the charge was used to generate the target product and that the catalyst’s turnover frequency was high; calculations and experiments attributed the reaction to a “radical rebound” mechanism, in which the generated hydroperoxyl radical first binds to the catalyst and then releases hydrogen peroxide.
sentences.zh: 实验室结果显示，超过99%的电荷用于生成目标产物，催化剂转换频率很高；计算与实验将反应归为“自由基回弹”机制，即生成的过氧羟基自由基先与催化剂结合，再释放过氧化氢。

sentences.en: The research team noted that the catalyst’s stability and lifetime still require testing and improvement and that scaling up the reaction and running it in water remain to be verified; the work is currently still at the laboratory stage.
sentences.zh: 研究团队指出，催化剂稳定性和寿命仍需测试改进，反应放大及在水中的运行也待验证，目前尚处实验室阶段。
